raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: Pneumorrhachis is defined by the presence of air within the spinal canal; Figure 1 (chest CT) shows intraspinal air, and Figure 3 (neck CT) demonstrates air extending into the neural exit foramen, confirming the diagnosis. Other options describe pneumomediastinum, subcutaneous emphysema, or pleural findings which are associated but not diagnostic of pneumorrhachis itself.
